name: Transpacific Food Inc
old_description: From berries to fruit to high-quality purees, Transpacific Food brings you nature’s best.
about:
Transpacific Food Inc opened its doors in 2000 in Salem, Oregon, under the leadership of CEO Bob Underwood, a third-generation farmer whose family experience in agriculture shapes the company’s approach. The business began with a focus on delivering high-quality fruit products to buyers seeking reliable sourcing and consistent quality.

The company produces high-quality fruit purees and creates custom formulations tailored to client specifications for color, consistency, and flavor. Its laboratory serves as an R&D partner, developing pure fruit blends for both large manufacturers needing agility and smaller brands requiring cost-effective product development. Transpacific sources berries and fruit from domestic and international growers, managing a supply chain that includes rigorous quality assurance, food safety documentation, and hands-on inspections at grower and co-packer facilities. The operation handles orders ranging from unique small batches to million-pound volumes, and also assists with logistics, packaging, and labeling challenges.

Transpacific serves fruit buyers across the food and beverage industry, including ingredient suppliers, processors, and brands developing new products. Larger companies leverage the firm’s formulation expertise and flexible production, while smaller businesses use its R&D services to bring products to market. The company’s customer base spans any sector requiring consistent, high-quality fruit ingredients.

The company says its differentiation lies in a vast sourcing network that draws from the Pacific Northwest and global regions, combined with a stringent approval process that includes in-person inspections of every grower and co-packer. Its mission emphasizes innovation, creativity, integrity, and efficiency, aiming to be the first call for fruit buyers. The leadership’s generational farming background informs a commitment to delivering fruit at peak quality, backed by a quality assurance program that spans from field to delivery.
